recent_posts: Same as post, already in English.

The Iraqi dinar recorded 1,310 to the dollar, nearly stable for about a week and within a range that did not exceed 1.2% over the past year. A recent report notes that Iraq needs new Gulf oil export routes to ease mounting financial pressure. #Iraq $IQD

The Mauritanian ouguiya recorded 40.1 to the dollar, its weakest level over the past year, after declining 0.9% since the start of the year within a trading range that did not exceed 1.6% during that period. #Mauritania $MRU
The Kuwaiti dinar recorded 0.309 against the dollar, nearly stable for about a week, and has not seen a stronger level in 25 days, after weakening 1.1% over the past year. #Kuwait $KWD
